features.title: The free 3D Studio connector for ChatGPT
features.summary: The three.ws 3D Studio connector is a Streamable HTTP MCP server at one URL that ChatGPT can add with no key, no account and no wallet. The /openai page asks the live server for its tool list on load and shows how many tools answered. The generation tools return interactive 3D that renders inline in the conversation. The page also covers the Custom GPT Actions route for plans without connector support.

features.title: Spatial MCP: 3D as a native tool result
features.summary: Spatial MCP is an open CC0 shape for returning a live 3D scene as a first-class MCP tool result instead of a URL in text. three.ws publishes a validator, a reference renderer and a checker page where anyone can paste a payload. A deliberately broken example shows how each error names its path and the fix. The shape is meant to be adopted by any MCP host.

features.title: One link from ChatGPT to AR
features.summary: When ChatGPT generates a model through the connector, it can hand back a single three.ws link that opens that model in a viewer. On a phone the same link offers one tap to place it in your space with AR. The link takes the GLB address and a title and needs no account.
